# Unit tests of drc/rules. Owner: RULES (openspec/changes/m3-drc/design.md
# D1/D2). Every *_test.cpp here is compiled into hefesto_drc_rules_tests;
# extra libraries or definitions go below.

hefesto_add_area_tests(drc_rules DATA_DIR drc/rules)

# Magic's scmos.tech, generated by tests/unit/tech when the reference tree
# build/ref/magic exists (tests skip otherwise).
target_compile_definitions(hefesto_drc_rules_tests PRIVATE
  HEFESTO_SCMOS_TECH="${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/tests/unit/tech/magic-tech/scmos.tech")
